<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">A 6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">A 1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">A 1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">A 1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">A 1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="ADD">6'b100000</param>
        <param id="ADDU">6'b100001</param>
        <param id="SUB">6'b100010</param>
        <param id="SUBU">6'b100011</param>
        <param id="AND">6'b100100</param>
        <param id="OR">6'b100101</param>
        <param id="XOR">6'b100110</param>
        <param id="NOR">6'b100111</param>
        <param id="SLT">6'b101010</param>
        <param id="SLTU">6'b101011</param>
        <param id="SLL">6'b000000</param>
        <param id="SRL">6'b000010</param>
        <param id="SRA">6'b000011</param>
        <param id="SLLV">6'b000100</param>
        <param id="SRLV">6'b000110</param>
        <param id="SRAV">6'b000111</param>
        <param id="LUI">6'b001111</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="a_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand a.</assign>
        <assign id="b_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand b.</assign>
        <assign id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the ALU operation.</assign>
        <assign id="zero">1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry">1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="negative">1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow">1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="flag">General flag output based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</assign>
        
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the ALU operation.</reg>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= $signed(a_signed) + $signed(b_signed);
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= $signed(a_signed) - $signed(b_signed);
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= ($signed(a_signed) < $signed(b_signed)) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[31:16], 16'h0};
                default: res <= 32'hxxxxxxxx;
            endcase
        end
        
        <assign id="zero" width_description="[0:0]">Zero output indicates whether the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry" width_description="[0:0]">Carry output indicates whether a carry occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="negative" width_description="[0:0]">Negative output indicates whether the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow" width_description="[0:0]">Overflow output indicates whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</assign>
        <assign id="flag" width_description="[0:0]">Flag output represents a general flag based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</assign>
        
        <assign zero = (res == 32'h00000000) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        <assign carry = (aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) ? ((res[31] != a_signed[31]) && (res[31] != b_signed[31])) : 1'bz;
        <assign negative = res[31];
        <assign overflow = (aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB) ? (a_signed[31] == b_signed[31] && res[31] != a_signed[31]) : 1'bz;
        <assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? res[0] : 1'bz;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations based on the aluc signal.</implementation>
</module>
